senses.definition: The feel or shape of a surface or substance; the smoothness, roughness, softness, etc. of something.
examples: The beans had a grainy, gritty texture in her mouth.

senses.definition: (art) The quality given to a work of art by the composition and interaction of its parts.
examples: The piece of music had a mainly homophonic texture.

senses.definition: (computer graphics) An image applied to a polygon to create the appearance of a surface.
examples: The videocard is responsible for drawing every polygon, texture, and particle effect in every game you play.

senses.definition: (obsolete) The act or art of weaving.
